tasks.label: CALM: Watch (run on save)
tasks.command: while true; do inotifywait -e close_write ${file} 2>/dev/null || fswatch -1 ${file} 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p .calm && stack-fitness-functions client validate --file ${relativeFile} --repo ${workspaceFolderBasename} --git-dir ${workspaceFolder} --format sarif > .calm/results.sarif; done
